editorial.blurb: A gem in Black Rock serving beautifully executed Thai cuisine in a stunning dining room where the chef's passion shines through every dish.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive during happy hour at the bar for great bites and drinks, and save room for dessert—the mango sticky rice and lychee crème brûlée are worth the space.

topDishes.note: A showstopper that satisfies and impresses
The best reviewers have had in a long time
